name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_kannada: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ - ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಜನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
short_description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
detailed_description: PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme aimed at providing a health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) that form the bottom 40% of the Indian population.
description_kannada: ಬಡ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ನಗದು ರಹಿತ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Family Annual Income Limit
rules.source_citation: AB-PMJAY Guidelines, Deprivation Criteria based on SECC 2011 / State NFSA lists
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your approximate total annual family income in rupees?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒಟ್ಟು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ಎಷ್ಟು?

benefits_summary: Cashless treatment and secondary/tertiary hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year.
application_process: Visit the official portal at pmjay.gov.in or beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
Enter your mobile number and authenticate via OTP to check SECC eligibility.
Verify your family details using Ration Card or Aadhaar number.
Visit any empaneled public or private hospital with your Ayushman Card for cashless admission.
source_title: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source_excerpt: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides cashless access to healthcare services for the beneficiary at the point of service, that is, the hospital.
